heroLede: Hands-on craft workshops and upcycled creations in Aurora, Colorado, where everyday materials become meaningful creations.
missionText: Helping children transform everyday materials into meaningful creations, discovering the value of their ideas, talents, and voices along the way.
monthlyTheme: Each month has a theme. This season it's all about birds: birdhouses, feeders, and feathered friends. Past projects include dreamy dried-flower mason jar lanterns for back-to-school crafting.
